  5. **Market Relations (العلاقات والأسواق):** Opening new pathways across B2G (government & municipalities), B2B (enterprises), and B2C markets.

## Key Managed Initiatives & Products at HEXO Verse
1. **Rawaa (رَواء) — Smart Water Distribution & Municipal IoT Solution**
   - Summary: Integrated smart water distribution system combining IoT hardware with a cloud dashboard and mobile application to help municipal water networks track distribution and minimize water loss.
   - Mohammad's Role: Contributing to the commercial and market evolution of Rawaa toward municipal adoption and regional expansion; assessing municipal needs, structuring commercial models and proposals, and forging partnerships from field testing to scale. Documented pilot results in Nuba village demonstrating up to 30% reduction in water loss.
   - Official Links: https://rawaa.net | https://www.hexoverse.com/startups/rawaa.html

2. **Namou (نمو) — AI-Powered Marketing Assistant for SMEs**
   - Summary: Conversational marketing platform operating via Telegram ("Ad Agency in a Pocket") enabling micro-businesses, home-based stores, and startups to generate localized ad copy and social media visuals in under a minute.
   - Mohammad's Role: Researched operational challenges across 100+ local micro-businesses, developed go-to-market outreach plans, and structured tiered subscription proposals for entrepreneurial incubators and business networks.
   - Official Links: https://namou.online | https://www.hexoverse.com/startups/namou.html

3. **Fath (فذ) — Interactive Edutainment Platform**
   - Summary: Gamified educational initiative and interactive quiz contest platform connecting smart physical buzzer tables with digital applications for schools, universities, and community events.
   - Mohammad's Role: Authored corporate sponsorship packages, planned digital social media outreach across TikTok and Instagram, and prepared introductory presentation decks for academic and community institutions.
   - Official Links: https://www.fath-app.com/ | https://sponsors.fath-app.com/
